_README: R-8 §1. The human half of scripts/preflight.mjs.
Each key below is something no program can establish from inside a
process: a DNS record resolving, a certificate terminating, a restore
actually performed, an SMS reaching a handset, a push landing on a phone,
an alert waking a person. The preflight checks whether the CONFIGURATION
for each exists; this file records whether the THING actually happened.
An entry counts only when result is "pass" and verifiedOn is a real date.
Attestations lapse after 180 days: 'we restored a backup successfully'
stops being a fact about the current system fairly quickly.
Do not fill this in from intent, from a plan, or from a strong belief that
something would work. Every entry is currently null because none of these
has been done, and a null here is worth more than a confident guess.
